witnesses.name: proclus-taylor-elements-theology-and-theology-of-plato-1816
witnesses.why: the same 1816 edition transcribed a second time — Taylor's Six Books on the Theology of Plato (1816) as the shelf holds it whole, with the Elements of Theology and the treatises; the shelf records it as a second transcription of the same print, MEASURED (sampled 40-letter runs from every part of both volumes stand in it at a uniform rate), and it is the witness a reading of this edition is checked against
